scripts.build:client: cd client && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm ci && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy
scripts.sync:client-to-server: mkdir -p server/public && rm -rf server/public/* && cp -r client/dist/* server/public
scripts.build:render: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run sync:client-to-server
